title: The WebSocket protocol specifies two-way communication between a client and a host that has opted in
summary: The WebSocket protocol specifies two-way communication between a client and a host that has opted in.
body: RFC 6455 says the WebSocket protocol enables two-way communication between a client running untrusted code in a controlled environment and a remote host that has opted in to communications from that code. The source says: "December 2011 The WebSocket Protocol Abstract The WebSocket Protocol enables two-way communication between a client running untrusted code in a controlled environment to a remote host that has opted-in to communications from that code." The opt-in is part of the abstract. A WebSocket is not an open pipe to an arbitrary machine that did not complete the handshake.
said_by: I. Fette and A. Melnikov, RFC 6455
